Container.Name: Birdsong
Container.Overview:
🐦 Birdsong - your garden's birds as an 1800s naturalist's plate
Birdsong draws the birds your BirdNET-Go station has heard as a single plate of hand-cut 1800s illustrations, each bird sized by how often it called.
🎨 About 1,400 antique bird illustrations built in, no setup. 📅 Today, seven days, thirty days or all time, refreshed every minute. 🔎 Select a bird for a short description, calls by hour and by day, and its latest recordings with playback and spectrogram. 🖼️ One-screen mode fits the plate and the species index on a single page, ideal for a wall display.
Requires BirdNET-Go, installed separately. Set its address below, then open the WebUI.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port the Birdsong page is served on.

Config.Name: BirdNET-Go Address
Config.Description: Address of your BirdNET-Go, with http:// and its port, for example http://192.168.1.50:8080. Use the server's IP, not localhost.

Config.Name: Data folder
Config.Description: Persistent folder for anything that must survive container updates. Unraid's per-container Tailscale finds it automatically and keeps its state here, so Birdsong keeps one tailnet identity across updates.
